params._coreAddress: Address of the EVVM virtual blockchain contract for payment processing
params._ownerOfShop: Address that will have administrative privileges over the shop

getIfUsedAsyncNonce(address,uint256).details: View function returning core.getIfUsedAsyncNonce(user, nonce). Reserved nonces return false until consumed.

returns._0: true if consumed, false if available/reserved

getNextCurrentSyncNonce(address).details: View function returning core.getNextCurrentSyncNonce(user). Auto-increments after each use.

orderCoffee(address,string,uint256,uint2.details: Signature format for client authorization:      "<evvmID>,orderCoffee,<coffeeType>,<quantity>,<totalPrice>,<nonce>"Reverts with InvalidSignature() if client signature verification failsReverts with NonceAlreadyUsed() if nonce has been previously used

params.isAsyncExec: Boolean flag indicating the type of nonce execution (true for async, false for sync)
params.isAsyncExecEvvm: Boolean flag indicating the type of nonce we are using                          (true for async nonce, false for sync nonce)
params.nonce: Unique number to prevent replay attacks (must not be reused)
params.nonceEvvm: Unique nonce for the EVVM payment transaction
params.priorityFeeEvvm: Fee paid for transaction priority in EVVM
params.quantity: Number of coffee units being ordered
params.signature: Client's signature authorizing the coffee order
params.signatureEvvm: Signature authorizing the EVVM payment transaction
params.totalPrice: Total price to be paid in ETH (in wei)
params.user: Address of the customer placing the order

stake(uint256).details: Only callable by the coffee shop owner

params.amountToStake: Number of staking tokens to stake

unstake(uint256).details: Only callable by the coffee shop owner

params.amountToUnstake: Number of staking tokens to unstake

withdrawFunds(address).details: Only callable by the coffee shop owner

params.to: Address where the withdrawn ETH will be sent

withdrawRewards(address).details: Only callable by the coffee shop owner

params.to: Address where the withdrawn reward tokens will be sent

constructor.notice: Initializes the coffee shop contract with EVVM integration

getIfUsedAsyncNonce(address,uint256).notice: Checks if async nonce was consumed

getNextCurrentSyncNonce(address).notice: Gets next sequential sync nonce for user

orderCoffee(address,string,uint256,uint2.notice: Processes a coffee order with payment through EVVM

stake(uint256).notice: Stakes a specified amount of staking tokens for the coffee shop service

unstake(uint256).notice: Unstakes a specified amount of staking tokens for the coffee shop service

withdrawFunds(address).notice: Withdraws accumulated ETH funds from coffee sales

withdrawRewards(address).notice: Withdraws accumulated virtual blockchain reward tokens from the contract
